label: GeneratorDeviceState
info:
Reads Generator Device State from registers:
- 62: Today Gen Energy (0.1kWh)
- 83: Daily Operating Time (0.1h)
- 92+95: Total Gen Energy (0.1kWh, 32-bit)
- 166: Gen Active Power (1W)
- 181: Gen Voltage (0.1V)
- 196: Gen Frequency (0.01Hz)

Triggers:
1. Periodic: Every 5 minutes (only sends if generator active)
2. RPC: getGeneratorDeviceState (always sends response)

Note: Each register read separately to avoid CRC errors.

name: Prepare read (Today 62)
